cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.34% · WTI +4.36% · Brent +4.28% · NatGas +1.44%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Oil & Gas Majors is doing the heavy lifting at +2.96%.

cards.headline: Oil & Gas Majors leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Oil & Gas Majors at +2.96%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -0.89%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BP is the standout at +4.11%
cards.body: Leaders: BP +4.11%, TTE +3.70%, APA +3.47%, EQNR +3.46%, SHEL +3.41%. Laggards: BE -3.29%, OKLO -2.06%, NXE -1.61%, UUUU -1.46%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
